name: Rokugatsu no Hell Area
source:
The month is June.

To end the war between the Human Realm and the Demon Kingdom, the two nations agreed to a marriage pact between their youths.

Thus, lovely soldier girls from the human side arrived to meet the three generals of the Demon Kingdom.

Amare, a brilliant strategist who'd come to cherish the hard-won peace despite the initial reluctance towards marriage, remained unaware of the tragedy that would soon unfold.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10171]Novelgame[/url]]
